```{r intro}
############## 
# 11_Ethiopia_DHS_CART 
# Ethiopia DHS 2016, Recode 7
# Decision tree for creation of typing tool
# input data: 5_Ethiopia_DHS_exploratory.rds
# ancestor code: 9b4_Ethiopia_DHS_LCA
# descendent code: 1
############## 
############## 
rm(list=ls())
pacman::p_load(dplyr, ggplot2, readr, sf, rpart, rpart.plot)
setwd("/Users/adigreif/Desktop/Gates Ethiopia/EthiopiaSegmentation/")
#setwd("C:/Users/anumi/OneDrive - Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation/All Pathways/WS06 Pathways/Pathways/Modeling/Ethiopia #Segmentation_v2/LCA/")

```

```{r urban}
dhs.seg.urban <- readRDS('dhs_urban_noage.rds')


#grow tree
set.seed(123)
tree_urban <- rpart(cluster_k5_rename ~ working.yn+pship.cat+ med.permis+wealth.index.ur+ med.index+dv.index+ jdwd.index.cat+partner.working.yn+religionrecode.cat+ work.seasonal+num.15up.4plus+conflict_incidents+num.kids.house.4plus+highestyearsedinHH.yrs+age.yrs+hh.electricity+any.media.yn+anyed.yn+early.sex.15, 
             data=dhs.seg.urban, method="class")

printcp(tree_urban) # display the results

plotcp(tree_urban) # visualize cross-validation results. note for pruning usually want to minimized cross validation error xerror

summary(tree_urban) # detailed summary of splits


```


```{r urbanplot, echo=FALSE}
# plot tree
plot(tree_urban, uniform=TRUE,
     main="Classification Tree for Urban LCA")
text(tree_urban, use.n=TRUE, all=TRUE, cex=.8)
```

```{r urbanplot2, echo=FALSE}
# plot tree
prp(tree_urban)
#mr=married, msl=muslim, oth=other, prs=poorest, Nwitp1m=no work in past 12 months 
```

```{r accuracyurban, echo=FALSE}
#### comparing to training data ######
PredictCART_train_urban = predict(tree_urban, data=dhs.seg.urban, type="class")
table(dhs.seg.urban$cluster_k5_rename, PredictCART_train_urban)
#predicted/total is diagonal entries out of total. 
#(5330-57-96)/5330=97%
```


```{r rural}
dhs.seg.rural <- readRDS('dhs_rural_noage.rds')


#grow tree
set.seed(123)
tree_rural <- rpart(cluster_k5_rename ~ working.yn+pship.cat+ med.permis+wealth.index.ur+ med.index+dv.index+ jdwd.index.cat+partner.working.yn+religionrecode.cat+ work.seasonal+num.15up.4plus+conflict_incidents+num.kids.house.4plus+highestyearsedinHH.yrs+age.yrs+hh.electricity+any.media.yn+anyed.yn+early.sex.15+pastoralnoagro, 
             data=dhs.seg.rural, method="class")

printcp(tree_rural) # display the results

plotcp(tree_rural) # visualize cross-validation results

summary(tree_rural) # detailed summary of splits


```


```{r ruralplot, echo=FALSE}
# plot tree
plot(tree_rural, uniform=TRUE,
     main="Classification Tree for Rural LCA")
text(tree_rural, use.n=TRUE, all=TRUE, cex=.8)
```
```{r ruralplot2, echo=FALSE}
# plot tree
prp(tree_rural)
```

```{r accuracyrural, echo=FALSE}
#### comparing to training data ######
PredictCART_train_rural = predict(tree_rural, data=dhs.seg.rural, type="class")
table(dhs.seg.rural$cluster_k5_rename, PredictCART_train_rural)
#predicted/total is diagonal entries out of total. 
#(10262-57-236)/10262=97%
```
